404.description: Market not found or not settled

image.description: Hub banner image URL. Empty when absent

icon.description: Hub icon URL. Empty when absent

startTime.description: Start of the hub's real-world event. Unset means no countdown

gateway.hubs.v1.Hub.description: Hub carries the display data for a link to a unified hub.

gateway.hubs.v1.HubStatus.description:
HubStatus matches the public unified Hub lifecycle.

 - HUB_STATUS_ACTIVE: The hub serves and appears in feed placements.
 - HUB_STATUS_ARCHIVED: The hub is retired and no longer serves.

gateway.market.v1.AssetPriceDirection.description: ONE_TOUCH direction. ASSET_PRICE_DIRECTION_UNSPECIFIED is returned on every market that is not a ONE_TOUCH.

gateway.market.v1.AssetPriceMarketType.description: How the market settles. ASSET_PRICE_MARKET_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED is returned for a market type newer than this schema: render the terms that are present.

gateway.market.v1.AssetPriceRangeKind.description: Which side of a RANGE market is open. ASSET_PRICE_RANGE_KIND_UNSPECIFIED is returned on every market that is not a RANGE.

indexSymbol.description: Reference index the market settles on, e.g. BRTI.

horizon.description: Supply-side horizon slug. Display and grouping only.

windowStart.description: Start of the settlement window. Always set for UP_DOWN. Null when the market has no settlement window (ladders).

windowEnd.description: End of the measurement window and scheduled settlement instant. Set on every automated crypto family, including ABOVE_BELOW and RANGE ladders. Use this rather than endDate for the settlement time. ONE_TOUCH may settle Yes before this instant.

priceToBeat.description: Null until stamped a few seconds after windowStart, and on every market that is not UP_DOWN.

strike.description: Null on every market that is not ABOVE_BELOW or ONE_TOUCH.

rangeLower.description: Null on every market that is not a RANGE, and on the open side of a tail range.

rangeUpper.description: Null on every market that is not a RANGE, and on the open side of a tail range.

settlementPrice.description: Null until resolved, and stays null on a ONE_TOUCH market that resolved No: no price was touched.

gateway.market.v1.AssetPriceTerms.description: Terms of a market settled against an external reference (index) price. Fields a market type does not use are null, never zero-filled. Prices are decimal strings exactly as the supply side stamped them.

gateway.market.v1.GetMarketBBOResponse.description: Response containing market BBO data in a lightweight format

gateway.market.v1.GetMarketBookResponse.description: Response containing market book data including order book and stats

marketType.description: Type of market (deprecated). Options: moneyline, spreads, totals

orderPriceMinTickSize.description: Minimum tick size for order price

ep3Status.description: Raw upstream EP3 instrument state (deprecated). Use status.

assetPriceTerms.description: Typed terms of an automated crypto price market. Null on every other market, including the hand-listed year-end crypto markets.

spreadTotalSuffix.description: Spread/total suffix for UI display (e.g. points, goals, runs)

sortOrder.description: Sort order for market within event

metadata.description: Opaque metadata object — internal-use only, shape is not part of the public contract

titleShort.description: Compact display title computed at serialization time (e.g. 'DET -5.5 F5', 'Over 5.5 F5'). Falls back to title.

ep3SyncedAt.description: Timestamp when this market was last synced from EP3

minimumTradeQty.description: Minimum order quantity in contracts (e.g. 0.01 = 1% of a contract, 1.0 = one whole contract).

rulesDisclaimer.description: Short 'understanding the rules' disclaimer for this market type, computed at serialization time. Omitted when the market's sports_market_type has no disclaimer.

rulesDisclaimerPopup.description: When true, clients should surface rules_disclaimer as a popup sheet the user acknowledges before buying, rather than inline. Only set when rules_disclaimer is present.

long.description: Whether market side is the long or short side of the market

tradable.description: Whether this side can be traded

gateway.market.v1.MarketStatus.description:
MarketStatus is the normalized trading lifecycle for a market, derived by the
gateway. Values may grow; treat unrecognized values as
MARKET_STATUS_UNSPECIFIED. Pre-trading upstream states have no counterpart
here and read as MARKET_STATUS_UNSPECIFIED.

 - MARKET_STATUS_RESOLVING: Past expiry, final settlement not yet published — payouts are pending.
 - MARKET_STATUS_RESOLVED: Final settlement published; the outcome will not change.

subjectType.description: Subject type (nominee, player, team, candidate, golf_player)

value.description: The amount as a decimal string.

gateway.types.v1.Amount.description: Represents a monetary amount with its currency.

symbol.description: Lower-case symbol within the class, e.g. btc. Matches [a-z0-9-], at most 64 characters.

gateway.types.v1.AssetId.description: Identifies one priced asset. The canonical string form is class:symbol, e.g. crypto:btc.

bidShares.description:
Total shares resting on the bid side: every level's positive quantity
summed, rounded down to two significant figures, the same contract as
the unified market frame so both surfaces show one number. "0" when the
side is empty; unset on a frame from a producer that predates this
field. bid_depth counts price levels, not shares.

askShares.description:
Total shares resting on the offer side, same rounding and empty
convention as bid_shares.

tradingReferenceSetTime.description: Time at which the trading reference price was set.

shared.market_data.v1.MarketStats.description: MarketStats are a collection of stats on an instrument.

shared.market_data.v1.SettlementPriceCal.description:
SettlementPriceCalculationMethod indicates the settlement price calculation method of the book.

 - SETTLEMENT_PRICE_CALCULATION_METHOD_VWAP_TIER_1: If using the VWAP Settlement Price Logic, indicates that there were enough trades to calculate the settlement price using Volume Weighted Average Price
 - SETTLEMENT_PRICE_CALCULATION_METHOD_VWAP_TIER_2_RULE_1: If using the VWAP Settlement Price Logic, indicates that there weren't enough trades to calculate the settlement price using VWAP, and the Best Bid / Best Ask / Last Trade / Previous Settlement logic was used instead, with Best Bid / Best Ask / Last Trade existing.
 - SETTLEMENT_PRICE_CALCULATION_METHOD_VWAP_TIER_2_RULE_2: If using the VWAP Settlement Price Logic, indicates that there weren't enough trades to calculate the settlement price using VWAP, and the Best Bid / Best Ask / Last Trade / Previous Settlement logic was used instead, with Best Bid / Best Ask existing and Last Trade not existing.
 - SETTLEMENT_PRICE_CALCULATION_METHOD_VWAP_TIER_2_RULE_3: If using the VWAP Settlement Price Logic, indicates that there weren't enough trades to calculate the settlement price using VWAP, and the Best Bid / Best Ask / Last Trade / Previous Settlement logic was used instead, with Best Bid / Last Trade existing and Best Ask not existing.
 - SETTLEMENT_PRICE_CALCULATION_METHOD_VWAP_TIER_2_RULE_4: If using the VWAP Settlement Price Logic, indicates that there weren't enough trades to calculate the settlement price using VWAP, and the Best Bid / Best Ask / Last Trade / Previous Settlement logic was used instead, with Best Bid existing and Best Ask / Last Trade not existing.
 - SETTLEMENT_PRICE_CALCULATION_METHOD_EVENT_TIER_1: Indicates that the settlement price was set as a result of "PerformResolution".  In addition, settlement prices that have this calculation method are considered final and will no longer be updated by the Settlement Price Module.
 - SETTLEMENT_PRICE_CALCULATION_METHOD_EVENT_TIER_2: If using the EVENT Settlement Price Logic, indicates that the settlement price was set to the price of the trading day's latest trade for the Opposing Side = "As Defined" sub type
 - SETTLEMENT_PRICE_CALCULATION_METHOD_EVENT_TIER_3: If using the EVENT Settlement Price Logic, indicates that at the market close no trades for the Opposing Side = "As Defined" sub type during the trade day, and therefore the settlement price was set to the current settlement price
 - SETTLEMENT_PRICE_CALCULATION_METHOD_EVENT_TIER_4: If using the EVENT Settlement Price Logic, indicates that there were no trades for the Opposing Side = "As Defined" sub type during the trade day, nor current settlement price, and therefore the settlement price was set to 0
 - SETTLEMENT_PRICE_CALCULATION_METHOD_OVERRIDE: Indicates the calculated settlement price was overridden by the exchange
 - SETTLEMENT_PRICE_CALCULATION_METHOD_VWAP_TIER_2_RULE_5: If using the VWAP Settlement Price Logic, indicates that there weren't enough trades to calculate the settlement price using VWAP, and the Best Bid / Best Ask / Last Trade / Previous Settlement logic was used instead, with Best Ask / Last Trade existing and Best Bid not existing.
 - SETTLEMENT_PRICE_CALCULATION_METHOD_VWAP_TIER_2_RULE_6: If using the VWAP Settlement Price Logic, indicates that there weren't enough trades to calculate the settlement price using VWAP, and the Best Bid / Best Ask / Last Trade / Previous Settlement logic was used instead, with Best Ask existing and Best Bid / Last Trade not existing.
 - SETTLEMENT_PRICE_CALCULATION_METHOD_VWAP_TIER_2_RULE_7: If using the VWAP Settlement Price Logic, indicates that there weren't enough trades to calculate the settlement price using VWAP, and the Best Bid / Best Ask / Last Trade / Previous Settlement logic was used instead, with Last Trade existing and Best Bid / Best Ask not existing.
 - SETTLEMENT_PRICE_CALCULATION_METHOD_VWAP_TIER_2_RULE_8: If using the VWAP Settlement Price Logic, indicates that there weren't enough trades to calculate the settlement price using VWAP, and the Best Bid / Best Ask / Last Trade / Previous Settlement logic was used instead, with Best Bid / Best Ask / Last Trade not existing.
